protocol: Two complete warmup rounds, 7 measured rounds; isolated child per version/runtime/mode. Same values, randomized lookups, atomic batches, fsync barriers, assertions, compaction and reopen. Runtime order reverses version order. No timing assertion in correctness gates.
units: milliseconds per workload; 1000 reads, scan rows or atomic batch mutations
limitations: One darwin arm64 host and warm filesystem cache. Not cold-device latency, power-loss certification, or a universal speed ranking. sync mode blocks its calling thread.
